verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke has a dedicated cyber-security service page saying its team helps clients "anticipate, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents", which is first-party evidence of incident-response work. The pack shows nothing on regulator-facing work such as breach notifications or supervisory-authority engagement, and nothing on what the breach-response offering involves. missing for 10: explicit regulator-facing breach work (e.g. notifications, data protection authority investigations), detail on the scope of the incident-response service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Our international team advises across the full spectrum of cyber-related issues, ensuring you are well-prepared to anticipate, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents.
